The corruption receipt captures the entire original row/full identity, refuses
foreign, absent, stale, cancelled and changed replacements, and permits exactly
one field/row delta. Cleanup is registered before relaxation. PostgreSQL restores
the exact original validated constraints, not all FKs or a NOT VALID surrogate.
SQLite restores/verifies original connection settings or discards the physical
connection. Independent bounded cleanup ignores the originating cancellation;
failed full-row restoration disposes the selected owner and reports the error.

### Transaction-Path Controls

The final combined race receipt runs all eight mandated EXISTING roots:
TestTransactionCancellationRollbackOrders; TestTransactionDoesNotSuppressCallbackTxDone;
TestReviewerTransactionPanicCleanup; TestTransactionExitFaultDisposition;
TestReviewerBusyAtCommitRecovery; TestRunTransactionQueuedCancellationPreventsCallbackEntry;
TestRunReadTransactionBypassesMutationAdmission; and
TestRunReadTransactionPreservesSnapshotAndCallerCancellation.
SQLite package PASS17.690s on the completed extraction.

The same receipt separately runs four NEW roots: TestAgentSnapshotConnectionScopeFailureCuts
(partial prepare, Begin failure and cleanup failure/discard),
TestAgentSnapshotCorruptionConnectionScopeRestoresEnforcement,
TestAgentSnapshotCorruptionConnectionScopeConservesFailedWork (callback error,
cancellation and panic), and TestAgentSnapshotCorruptionUsesOriginalWriterAdmission
(held original writer and queued cancellation). These transport controls are
additional to, not substitutes for, the complete native agent-row proofs.
The runtimepersistence part of that completed extraction receipt passes156.936s:
ten native/structural roots, both stores for all four executing hostile roots,
and no skips/failures. Together with SQLite it is22 root passes. The later
fixture-only naming repair does not change the transaction extraction, barriers,
event adapters or unchanged original cells; those receipts carry.
